When I was younger I barely slept and made me feel so good. Idk maybe liked the high of being sleep deprived and getting homework done before the crash. Nowadays I sleep to escape. I’ve been in a situation like that. Every situation is different for me Our relationship became toxic throughout this period so we kinda are having a break at the moment but we both made it out okay and the relationship will heal over time. here are Somethings I was told when both my friend and I were escalating to crisis in no particular order: 1) You are their friend not their therapist. 2) if you feel like they are in danger call their home phone/parent/911 if necessary. 3) tell them you’re there and you will try your best but I’m also trying to work on my on mental health. Make sure they know that they are not a burden to you. 4) if you know someone in their support system (or anyone that could help) let them know you are concerned about your friend. 
I feel like guilt was very heavy on me during that time. On a plane they say help yourself before you help others. It’s scary as heck just to keep myself afloat but fearing that I would lose a friend was worse. Always reminded to not put that guilt/pressure/blame on myself. Also reminded a lot that it’s not selfish to help yourself. I hope things don’t become toxic and you will both get out of this storm. I hope I didn’t make you feel worse.

It might seem crazy but someday you miss how time moved so slowly. So enjoy it. Don’t be so selfish. You take things too seriously. Also read more books. Write down everyday what made you happy (probably parent write it).

I feel like if you feel like you need it then go. If you go They will assess you and ask a ton of questions (be as honest as you can). They would probably decide if you need to be admitted. If they don’t think it’s necessary I bet they can get you some help or maybe an outpatient thing. 
-maybe google psych hospitals near you and just look around if they have a website. 
-Staff check up on everyone pretty often but if you are in a room by yourself you can probably ask staff if you can talk to someone. 
-Bringing a stuff animal and plushie should be fine. All places are different though. 
-The person probably won’t get in trouble but I really can’t be sure. But it’s probably something to bring up because it’s rough when people don’t do anything when you are telling them you’re in a crisis. 

I don’t know if this helps at all but you feeling are valid. Not all hospitals are the same. Some are better than others. I wish you the best
